entries.c9e63adc2e8b9176: Revenue for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥16,030 million. In sales promotion-related business, orders were firm for the production of flyers and in-store promotional materials associated with new store openings and sale campaigns of major clients, and for ISP and BPO-related work; projects such as catalog production and Web-related and public relations publications from local governments also increased. However, New Year's card-related orders declined in number due to a structural reduction in demand for New Year's cards, and overall revenue fell below the previous fiscal year.

entries.e911ebf4d7cf2f9e: A single segment spanning both the advertising industry and the printing industry. In addition to manufacturing commercial printing and New Year's card printing through an integrated system at its own plants, it manufactures sign products, produces Web and digital content, plans SP (sales promotion) campaigns, and provides BPO, internet connection services, and the planning, printing and publishing of free papers. The consolidated subsidiary Print House Co., Ltd. engages in on-demand printing, and Aji Kaori Senryaku Kenkyusho Co., Ltd. provides promotional support by analyzing food taste and turning it into data. Net sales for the fiscal year ended July 2026 were ¥16,030 million.
